Open to partners or investors to fund promotion and run day-to-day operations, with full technical support from Jagapathi as a priority
- Elevated Goat & Poultry Shed (live 3D/VR model: https://jagapathibanoth6-dotcom.github.io/gaot-shed/): 75 x 50 ft elevated steel shed for ~200 goats with poultry underneath; 37 design versions; full bill of quantities ≈ ₹52.65 lakh; Three.js + WebXR, runs on phone, PC and Meta Quest 3S
- Future House (live 3D/VR model: https://jagapathibanoth6-dotcom.github.io/Future-house/ ; floor plans and budget: https://jagapathibanoth6-dotcom.github.io/Future-house/plan.html): 36 x 40 ft G+1 home, ~2,556 sq ft, 4 bedrooms, home theatre; electrical and plumbing layouts; budget ≈ ₹61 lakh
- Smart Starter & Transformer Gateway (upcoming): two-part connected motor-control system for farms sharing a transformer. Part 1: smart three-phase starter at each motor (ESP32-S3, dual power metering, 5 kV isolation, fail-safe contactor; PCBs routed and checked, prototypes next). Part 2: gateway at the transformer measuring voltage and phase currents, with one SIM internet connection, controlling 5–30 starters by LoRa within ~5 km. Sequenced one-by-one motor starting to protect the transformer from load surges; control by mobile app and by a remote control with a 5 km range
